item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03110","case1_error":"Counts Reece's ladder only once, omitting his 15 climbs.","case2_error":"Multiplies already annual spending by 52 again; also incorrectly evaluates 468 × 52 as 24,576.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required repetition factor; case 2 applies that factor twice and additionally miscalculates the product.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03111","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of compensating for rope lost during lashing.","case2_error":"Treats one-tenth as an absolute daily episode count instead of calculating one-tenth of 50 episodes.","reason":"Case 1 reverses the adjustment for loss; case 2 substitutes a proportion for the quantity that proportion represents.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03112","case1_error":"Performs four successive donations although the question specifies two.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final total of 24,000 after correctly specifying the pixel dimensions and multiplication formula.","reason":"Case 1 executes extra iterations; case 2 supplies an incorrect number without showing a numerical calculation supporting it.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03113","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter-share, omitting Chris's equally required withdrawal.","case2_error":"Values each pile as one coin, omitting the ten coins per pile.","reason":"Both count a required repeated contribution only once, omitting its multiplicity: two withdrawals in case 1 and ten coins per pile in case 2.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03114","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2,175 instead of 1,975.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the explicitly written lunch-minus-breakfast expression as $5 instead of $4.","reason":"Both numerically misevaluate a correctly written expression representing the requested calculation.","judgment":"same"}]}
